text: session-start console autostart: the pidfile liveness probe os.kill(pid, 0) is not a Windows existence check. Reproduced 2026-11-05: console PID alive and serving on 7146, OpenProcess(ALL_ACCESS) succeeds, yet os.kill(pid, 0) raises WinError 87 for a process this interpreter did not spawn (Python 3.14; the docs say other versions TerminateProcess instead). The hook then falls to the socket probe and reports 'port already in use by another process' for our own console, printing no URL. Fix: on win32 probe with ctypes OpenProcess+GetExitCodeProcess==STILL_ACTIVE (stdlib), or on a busy port GET /live/console.json and treat a payload naming this repo root as ours; add a test for a live pidfile whose process the hook did not spawn. Found in alpha checklist item 4.

dist: the fresh and adopt-kit zips do not ship .gitattributes (home repo has '*.sh text eol=lf' and '.claude/hooks/* text eol=lf'). Seen 2026-11-06 in item 7's fresh adoption on Windows: git add printed 'LF will be replaced by CRLF' for every kit file, so the hooks are LF today but the next checkout/switch/stash that touches them rewrites them CRLF and bash breaks; doctor only catches it afterwards. Fix: distctl export ships a .gitattributes at the kit root (fresh and adopt-kit; adopt merges it like the gitignore block) and doctor WARNs when the repo has no eol=lf rule for .claude/hooks/*; test in test_dist.py.

Fix: add .cview/ to the managed block (memory.json/distctl) and the home .gitignore; add the instruction sentence to .claude/CLAUDE.md and skills/adopt/CLAUDE.template.md, worded so the nudge-wording guard (no verb directly before /project-memory) stays green - the throwaway repo cview-fresh holds a working diff (commits 9a0667f, 2ee7c58); rebuild the zips.

Cview readiness E3 (decision needed): statectl dispatch and accept run 'git worktree add/remove' and accept merges the branch, while Cview's E3 wants nothing under .claude/ running git worktree and E7 forbids the main session merging. Options: (a) dispatch and accept refuse when .cview/ exists at the repo root - the pick: smallest change, same trigger CLAUDE.md already uses, fableous mode untouched elsewhere; (b) accept as-is since only user-typed commands, never hooks, run them; (c) strip worktree and merge code from both. E4 (git rev-parse vs the .claude-ancestor root resolver) is accepted as equivalent, no change.

note: ruled 2026-11-08: option (a), refuse under .cview/; goes into the beta.1 fix card

text: adopt --upgrade cannot follow its own procedure on a customised install (extrct_private, 2026-11-08: 71 of the system's files differed). The skill's rule 'different = drift, do not touch' cannot tell an old upstream version from a real customisation, so the agent deviated into a 3-way merge against the alpha.1 tag, classifying each file by the source's git history (git log --all -- <f> + rev-parse <c>:<f>, comparing blobs not working-tree bytes because autocrlf made 136 files look drifted). Design for stable 0.3: make the 3-way merge the documented upgrade path - base = the target's system_version tag in the source checkout, theirs = target, ours = source; auto-apply 'old upstream, no local change' and clean merges, report conflicts; compare blobs; never touch state. Alternatively keep copy-only and have the skill STOP with the classification table instead of merging. Checklist item 7's 'nothing overwritten' expectation was not met as written; the outcome was green (doctor 15 ok, suite 955 passed) and transparent.

mapctl.cap_boxes: the 'other' fold of planned (lazy) cards is emitted with _lazy: False, so an adopter with many planned cards (extrct_private: 99 planned library paths) gets the whole architecture spec blocked. A fold whose members are all lazy must be lazy (WARN, not error). Found and patched in extrct_private's upgrade 2026-11-08 (docs/system-arch/log/2026-11.md); port the fix here with a test in test_architecture.py.

Five suite tests assume a fresh kit and fail on a customised adoption (extrct_private, 2026-11-08): test_contracts deny regex rejects Read(...) deny rules an adopter added; test_dist expects CREDITS/NOTICE at the repo root (an adopter with its own root LICENSE keeps the system's inside .claude/); test_ritual tagless-generator assumes project_steps empty; test_worktree real-worktree test assumes no policy.record_root override; test_context asserts the default guide size target instead of the configured knob. Fix: each test reads the config it depends on or scopes itself to kit files; the shipped suite must be green on any adoption that doctor passes.
